arxiv-1711-05186.title: False Positive and Cross-relation Signals in Distant Supervision Data
arxiv-1711-05186.creator: Anca Dumitrache, Lora Aroyo, Chris Welty
arxiv-1711-05186.description: Abstract Distant supervision (DS) is a well-established method for relation extraction from text, based on the assumption that when a knowledge-base contains a relation between a term pair, then sentences that contain that pair are likely to express the relation.

arxiv-2111-14288.title: Description of 93 Nb stellar electron-capture rates by the Projected Shell Model
arxiv-2111-14288.creator: Long-Jun Wang, Liang Tan, Zhipan Li, Bingshui Gao, Yang Sun
arxiv-2111-14288.description: Abstract Capture of electrons by nuclei is an important process in stellar environments where excited nuclear states are thermally populated. However, accurate treatment for excited configurations in electron capture (EC) rates has been an unsolved problem for medium-heavy and heavy nuclei.

arxiv-2210-03109.title: Real-World Robot Learning with Masked Visual Pre-training
arxiv-2210-03109.creator: Ilija Radosavovic Tete Xiao Stephen James Pieter Abbeel Jitendra Malik Trevor Darrell[4mm] University of California, Berkeley
arxiv-2210-03109.description: Abstract In this work, we explore self-supervised visual pre-training on images from diverse, in-the-wild videos for real-world robotic tasks. Like prior work, our visual representations are pre-trained via a masked autoencoder (MAE), frozen, and then passed into a learnable control module.

arxiv-2301-09863.title: Design and Validation of a Multi-Arm Relocatable Manipulator for Space Applications
arxiv-2301-09863.creator: Enrico Mingo Hoffman, Arturo Laurenzi, Francesco Ruscelli, Luca Rossini, Lorenzo Baccelliere, Davide Antonucci, Alessio Margan, Paolo Guria, Marco Migliorini, Stefano Cordasco, Gennaro Raiola, Luca Muratore, Joaquín Estremera Rodrigo, Andrea Rusconi, Guido Sangiovanni, Nikos G. Tsagarakis
arxiv-2301-09863.description: Abstract This work presents the computational design and validation of the Multi-Arm Relocatable Manipulator (MARM), a three-limb robot for space applications, with particular reference to the MIRROR (i.e., the Multi-arm Installation Robot for Readying ORUs and Reflectors) use-case scenario as proposed by the European Space Agency.

arxiv-2412-16143.title: Quantitative classicality in cosmological interactions during inflation
arxiv-2412-16143.creator: Yoann L. Launay, Gerasimos I. Rigopoulos, E. Paul S. Shellard
arxiv-2412-16143.description: Abstract We examine the classical and quantum evolution of inflationary cosmological perturbations from quantum initial conditions, using the on-shell and off-shell contributions to correlators to investigate the signatures of interactions. In particular, we calculate the Keldysh contributions to the leading order bispectrum from past infinity, showing that the squeezed limit is dominated by the on-shell evolution.

arxiv-2504-15047.title: RainbowPlus: Enhancing Adversarial Prompt Generation via Evolutionary Quality-Diversity Search
arxiv-2504-15047.creator: Quy-Anh Dang, Chris Ngo, Truong-Son Hy
arxiv-2504-15047.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to adversarial prompts that exploit safety mechanisms. Existing red-teaming methods face scalability challenges, computational bottlenecks, or limited attack diversity. We propose RainbowPlus , a framework that reconceptualizes adversarial prompt generation as evolutionary quality-diversity search, where diverse attack strategies co-evolve across behavioral niches.

arxiv-2508-14174.title: Fast, low noise CCD systems for future strategic x-ray missions
arxiv-2508-14174.creator: Haley R. Stueber, Abigail Y. Pan, Tanmoy Chattopadhyay, Steven W. Allen, Marshall W. Bautz, Kevan Donlon, Catherine E. Grant, Sven Herrmann, Beverly J. LaMarr, Andrew Malonis, Eric D. Miller, R. Glenn Morris, Peter Orel, Artem Poliszczuk, Gregory Y. Prigozhin, Daniel R. Wilkins
arxiv-2508-14174.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Haley R. Stueber, Abigail Y. Pan, Tanmoy Chattopadhyay, Steven W. Allen, Marshall W. Bautz, Kevan Donlon, Catherine E. Grant, Sven Herrmann, Beverly J. LaMarr, Andrew Malonis, Eric D. Miller, R. Glenn Morris, Peter Orel, Artem Poliszczuk, Gregory Y. Prigozhin, Daniel R. Wilkins. Future strategic X-ray missions, such as the Advanced X-ray Imaging Satellite (AXIS) and those targeted by the Great Observatories Maturation Program (GOMaP), require fast, low-noise X-ray imaging spectrometers.

arxiv-2509-07553.creator: Zheng Wu, Heyuan Huang, Xingyu Lou, Xiangmou Qu, Pengzhou Cheng, Zongru Wu, Weiwen Liu, Weinan Zhang, Jun Wang, Zhaoxiang Wang, Zhuosheng Zhang
arxiv-2509-07553.description: Abstract . With the rapid progress of multimodal large language models, operating system (OS) agents become increasingly capable of automating tasks through on-device graphical user interfaces (GUIs). However, most existing OS agents are designed for idealized settings, whereas real-world environments often present untrustworthy conditions.

arxiv-2512-14694.title: On in-in correlators for spinning theories and their shadow formulation
arxiv-2512-14694.creator: Chandramouli Chowdhury, Arthur Lipstein, Joe Marshall, Alex Jiayi Zhang
arxiv-2512-14694.description: Abstract In-in correlators are the basic observables in cosmology and are traditionally computed using the Schwinger-Keldysh formalism. In this paper we revisit this formalism for photons, gluons, and gravitons coupled to scalars in four dimensional de Sitter space and provide a novel treatment of boundary gauge-fixing of the underlying path integral.

arxiv-2601-14653.title: Efficient Imputation for Patch-based Missing Single-cell Data via Cluster-regularized Optimal Transport
arxiv-2601-14653.creator: Yuyu Liu, Jiannan Yang, Ziyang Yu, Weishen Pan, Fei Wang, Tengfei Ma
arxiv-2601-14653.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Yuyu Liu, Jiannan Yang, Ziyang Yu, Weishen Pan, Fei Wang, Tengfei Ma. Missing data in single-cell sequencing datasets poses significant challenges for extracting meaningful biological insights. However, existing imputation approaches, which often assume uniformity and data completeness, struggle to address cases with large patches of missing data. In this paper, we present CROT ( C luster- R egularized O ptimal T ransport), an optimal transport-based imputation algorithm designed to handle patch-based missing data in tabular formats.

arxiv-2602-11576.title: Control the qubit-qubit coupling with double superconducting resonators
arxiv-2602-11576.creator: Hui Wang, Rui Wang, Daichi Sugiyama, Chih-Yao Shih, Ching-Yeh Chen, Hiroto Mukai, Hang Xue, J.S. Tsai
arxiv-2602-11576.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Hui Wang, Rui Wang, Daichi Sugiyama, Chih-Yao Shih, Ching-Yeh Chen, Hiroto Mukai, Hang Xue, J.S. Tsai. We experimentally studied the switching off processes in the double-resonator coupler superconducting quantum circuit. In both frequency and time-domain, we observed the variation of qubit-qubit effective coupling by tuning the frequency differences between qubits and the double-resonator coupler.

Where examined, circRNAs are often highly stable and the mechanisms by which cells degrade and/or clear circRNAs from the cells are unknown. Here we...

pmc-10683964.title: Short-term Outcome of Robotic and Laparoscopic Surgery for Gynecological Malignancies: A Single-center Experience
pmc-10683964.creator: Corina-Elena Minciuna, Mihail Ivanov, Sanziana Aioanei, Stefan Tudor, Monica Lacatus, Catalin Vasilescu
pmc-10683964.description: Objectives:Minimally invasive surgery (MIS) has become the preferred option for many gynecologic pathologies since complication rate and postoperative recovery time have decreased considerably. Postoperative complications remain an important aspect when using the MIS approach, if they are not timely or accurately diagnosed and treated.

pmc-11644003.title: Clinical Efficacy of Probiotics for Allergic Rhinitis: Results of an Exploratory Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-11644003.creator: Lisa Lungaro, Patrizia Malfa, Francesca Manza, Anna Costanzini, Guido Valentini, Diletta Francesca Squarzanti, Elisa Viciani, Alena Velichevskaya, Andrea Castagnetti, Marianna Barbalinardo, Denis Gentili, Alessio Cariani, Sara Ghisellini, Fabio Caputo, Roberto De Giorgio, Giacomo Caio, Gang Wang
pmc-11644003.description: Background: Allergic Rhinitis (AR) is an atopic disease affecting the upper airways of predisposed subjects exposed to aeroallergens. This study evaluates the effects of a mix of specific probiotics (L. acidophilus PBS066, L. rhamnosus LRH020, B. breve BB077, and B. longum subsp. longum BLG240) on symptoms and fecal microbiota modulation in subjects with AR.

pmc-12609850.title: Multifocal Ocular Manifestations Heralding Relapse of Acute Myeloid Leukemia: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-12609850.creator: Elvia Mastrogiuseppe, Maria Carmela Saturno, Clara Minotti, Martina Angi, Marco Marenco
pmc-12609850.description: This case-based review examines the spectrum of leukemic ocular involvement, focusing on its prognostic implications. A rare case of relapsed acute myeloid leukemia (AML) in a 63-year-old man is presented, featuring simultaneous orbital proptosis, adnexal involvement, choroidal and retinal infiltration, and hemorrhagic changes affecting both the anterior and posterior segments.

pmc-12657747.title: First documented case of imported human babesiosis in Honduras: Diagnostic challenges with malaria falciparum
pmc-12657747.creator: Lesly Chaver, Heydi Flores, Wendy Padilla, Jenny Rodríguez, Concepción Zúniga, Francisco Medina, Gabriela Matamoros, María Esther Araujo, Bryan Ortiz, Gustavo Fontecha
pmc-12657747.description: Highlights•First confirmed case of imported human babesiosis documented in Honduras.•Initial misdiagnosis as Plasmodium falciparum malaria led to inappropriate antimalarial therapy.•Persistent hyperparasitemia despite chloroquine–primaquine and artemether–lumefantrine treatment.•Molecular assays excluded malaria and confirmed Babesia 18S rRNA, with retrospective detection of the Maltese cross.•Advanced age, cardiac comorbidity, and delayed diagnosis contributed to a fatal outcome.

pmc-12677099.title: Ginsenoside Rg1 alleviated testicular and sperm damage in rats exposed to bisphenol A
pmc-12677099.creator: Fatemeh Abdi, Hamed Shoorei, Ramji Kumar Bhandari, Bahareh Amin, Marzieh Kafami, Samad Nazemi
pmc-12677099.description: Bisphenol-A (BPA), a global environmental contaminant, is a well-known endocrine disruptor that can impair male reproductive function. The purpose of the study was to investigate the effects of ginsenoside Rg1 on alleviating BPA-induced testicular dysfunction and poor sperm quality.Adult male rats were divided into four groups: control, BPA, BPA + Rg1, and Rg1.

pmc-12732200.title: First Trimester Triglyceride-Glucose Index and Lipid Profile as Predictive Factors in the Diagnosis of Late-Onset Preeclampsia: Can We Prevent It?
pmc-12732200.creator: Cagla Bahar Bulbul, Betul Yakistiran, Ioannis Tsakiridis
pmc-12732200.description: Objectives: This study aimed to evaluate whether first-trimester metabolic markers—including the triglyceride-glucose (TyG) index and lipid-related ratios (TG/HDL-c, LDL-c/HDL-c, and TyG/BMI)—could predict the development of late-onset preeclampsia, and to assess their associations with birthweight and birth length. Methods: A retrospective cohort study was conducted on 306 pregnant women (153 with late-onset PE and 153 normotensive controls).

pmc-13153404.title: Comparative evaluation of machine learning and deep learning approaches for compressive strength prediction of geopolymer concrete
pmc-13153404.creator: H. Ezz, S. M. Bakr
pmc-13153404.description: Geopolymer concrete has emerged as a promising sustainable alternative to ordinary Portland cement concrete due to its lower environmental impact and favorable engineering performance. However, accurately predicting its compressive strength remains challenging because it is governed by complex interactions among binder composition, activator characteristics, curing conditions, and other mixture parameters.

pmc-13457281.title: Burden of Disease in Pediatric Tumor-Induced Osteomalacia: A Literature Review
pmc-13457281.creator: Salvatore Minisola, Suzanne M. Jan de Beur, Thomas O. Carpenter, Kathryn M. Dahir, María Belén Zanchetta, Leanne Ward, Ben Johnson, Neil Webb, Cody Broadhurst, Victoria Ward, Erik A. Imel
pmc-13457281.description: Tumor-induced osteomalacia (TIO) is an ultra-rare, paraneoplastic syndrome caused by tumors secreting fibroblast growth factor 23 (FGF23). In children, TIO may be mistaken for more common causes of rickets and osteomalacia, including monogenic forms, leading to long diagnostic delays. This review aimed to identify evidence on the diagnostic journey and burden of TIO in pediatric patients.

pmc-13557145.title: SIRT1 in Neurodegenerative Diseases: Molecular Mechanisms, Disease Relevance, and Therapeutic Potential
pmc-13557145.creator: Jiabin Duan, Jiaqi Liu, Qingsheng Meng, Jiahao Liu, Sitian Yang, Fang Zhou, Jing Cao
pmc-13557145.description: Neurodegenerative diseases are characterized by progressive protein aggregation, mitochondrial dysfunction, neuroinflammation, and cognitive decline, yet effective mechanism‐based interventions remain limited. Sirtuin 1 (SIRT1), an NAD+‐dependent deacetylase, has emerged as a multifunctional regulator linking stress adaptation, proteostasis, and metabolic homeostasis to disease progression.

pmc-13682906.title: Intensivists’ Perspectives and Practices on Palliative Care in the ICU: A Nationwide Survey in Korea
pmc-13682906.creator: Tae Jung Kim, Yoon Sun Jung, Ye Sul Jeung, Woo Hyun Cho, Shin Hye Yoo, Jae Young Moon
pmc-13682906.description: BackgroundWhile many countries have made progress in integrating palliative care into intensive care units (ICUs), implementation remains highly context-dependent. In Korea, palliative care integration within ICUs remains limited, and intensivists’ perspectives on its role and applicability have not been well studied.

pmc-13694439.title: Next-generation sequencing using a targeted gene panel in advanced solid tumors: five years of experience from an Italian referral institution
pmc-13694439.creator: Pasquale Pisapia, Antonino Iaccarino, Caterina De Luca, Francesco Pepe, Gianluca Russo, Mariantonia Nacchio, Domenica Di Giovanni, Domenico Cozzolino, Floriana Conticelli, Lucia Palumbo, Claudia Scimone, Gianluca Gragnano, Maria Russo, Maria Salatiello, Elena Vigliar, Claudio Bellevicine, Giancarlo
pmc-13694439.description: AimsNext generation sequencing (NGS) represents the “holy grail” for the diagnostic algorithm for advanced solid tumors. In our experience, we commonly use our customized DNA-based NGS panel (namely, SiRe®). The aim of this study was to assess the efficiency of our customized DNA-based NGS panel in detecting molecular alterations in both tissue and liquid biopsy samples.
